title: GREENcell – combination of a strain-hardened and passivated Al alloy foil anode with a F-free LiMn2O4 cathode
content:
Energy Adv., 2026, 5,97-109
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00287G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kathrin Schad, Nicolas Görnert, Christopher Markus Mehlich, Meichen Zhan, Kai Peter Birke
The novelty of this work lies in the optimization of the GREENcell-concept by combining a strain-hardened and passivated Al alloy foil anode with a F-free LiMn2O4 cathode for achieving a commercially viable, low-cost, and sustainable LiB.
